title: Unit 40 Consolidation: Inflected Postpositions
goal: I can command the full paradigm of inflected postpositions (előttem, nélkülem, helyettem, miattam, utánam).
I can navigate, socialize, apologize, and coordinate events effortlessly with postpositions.
